- main:
  - article:
    - heading "Privacy Policy" [level=1]
    - paragraph: "Last updated: October 19, 2026"
    - heading "Introduction" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Caro's Ledge ("we", "our", "the platform") is a freight sustainability intelligence platform operated by Pet Pursuit LLC. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information when you use our services.
    - paragraph: We process personal data in accordance with applicable laws including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the UK GDPR, and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
    - heading "Information We Collect" [level=2]
    - heading "Information You Provide" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Account information: name, email address, company affiliation, role"
      - listitem: "Workspace profile: organization name, freight sectors, transport modes, jurisdictions of interest"
      - listitem: "Your work in the platform: watchlists, notes, saved views, assignments and tags"
      - listitem: "Community content: your Community profile, your posts and replies, and your reports"
      - listitem: "Authentication credentials: passwords (stored as cryptographic hashes only)"
    - heading "Information We Collect Automatically" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, session timestamps"
      - listitem: "Error reports: when something fails in your browser or on our servers, the page, the message and the release are stored in our own database"
      - listitem: Cookies and similar technologies (see the Cookies section below)
    - heading "Information from Third Parties" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Public regulatory data ingested from official sources (does not include personal data)
    - heading "How We Use Information" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We use the information we collect to:"
    - list:
      - listitem: Provide, operate, and maintain the platform
      - listitem: Authenticate users and manage accounts
      - listitem: Personalize your experience based on workspace profile and freight sectors
      - listitem: Show you the regulatory analyses relevant to your operations
      - listitem: Notify you inside the platform about activity that concerns you, such as replies, invitations and assignments
      - listitem: Detect, prevent, and address technical issues, security incidents, and fraud
      - listitem: Comply with legal obligations
    - heading "Legal Bases for Processing (GDPR)" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Where GDPR applies, we process personal data on the following legal bases:"
    - list:
      - listitem: "Performance of a contract: to provide the services you've signed up for"
      - listitem: "Legitimate interests: to operate, secure, and improve our platform"
      - listitem: "Legal obligations: to comply with applicable laws"
      - listitem: "Consent: where required"
    - heading "Information Sharing" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We do not sell personal information. We share information only as described below:"
    - heading "Service Providers" [level=3]
    - paragraph: "These are the services this platform's code uses, and what each one receives:"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Supabase
        - text: ": Database, sign-in and file storage. It receives your account, your workspace and Community content, and your sign-in session."
      - listitem:
        - strong: Vercel
        - text: ": Hosting and content delivery. It receives each request to the site, including your IP address and browser type, and the logs of those requests."
      - listitem:
        - strong: GitHub Actions
        - text: ": Building and testing the platform's own code. It receives none of your personal data: it runs on the platform's code, not on member data."
      - listitem:
        - strong: Resend
        - text: ": Sending invitation e-mail. It receives the invited person's e-mail address and the name of the organisation that invited them. Only when a deployment has an e-mail provider configured. Otherwise an invitation is shared as a link and nothing is sent."
      - listitem:
        - strong: OpenStreetMap tile servers
        - text: ": Map tiles on the Regulations map. It receives your IP address and browser type, when the map loads."
    - heading "Legal Requirements" [level=3]
    - paragraph: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or government request, or to protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users or others.
    - heading "Business Transfers" [level=3]
    - paragraph: If Pet Pursuit LLC is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred. We will notify you and provide options before your information becomes subject to a different privacy policy.
    - heading "Data Retention" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We keep your personal information for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, we delete it in one step:"
    - list:
      - listitem: your account, your profile and your sign-in are deleted, with your memberships, watchlists, notes, saved views, notifications and preferences;
      - listitem: a workspace only you belonged to is deleted with you; a workspace shared with others is never left without an owner, so we ask you to make someone else an owner first;
      - listitem: what you wrote in Community stays, and is shown as written by a deleted member; a group you owned passes to its next admin;
      - listitem: our record of administrative acts keeps the act and its date but no longer names you.
    - heading "Your Rights" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Depending on your location, you may have the following rights, and each one below says where to use it:"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Access
        - text: ": get a copy of the personal information we hold about you. Use the controls below, or the route"
        - code: GET /api/account/export
        - text: while signed in.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Correction
        - text: ": correct inaccurate information. Change it on your"
        - link "profile":
          - /url: /profile
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - strong: Deletion
        - text: ": delete your account and your personal information (the right to be forgotten). Use the controls below, or the route"
        - code: DELETE /api/account
        - text: while signed in.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Portability
        - text: ": receive your information in a structured, machine-readable format. Use the controls below, or the route"
        - code: GET /api/account/export
        - text: while signed in.
      - listitem:
        - strong: Objection
        - text: ": object to certain types of processing. Write to"
        - link "privacy@carosledge.com":
          - /url: mailto:privacy@carosledge.com
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - strong: Restriction
        - text: ": ask us to limit how we process your information. Write to"
        - link "privacy@carosledge.com":
          - /url: mailto:privacy@carosledge.com
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - strong: Withdrawal of consent
        - text: ": withdraw consent where processing is based on it. Write to"
        - link "privacy@carosledge.com":
          - /url: mailto:privacy@carosledge.com
        - text: .
      - listitem:
        - strong: Complaint
        - text: ": lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority. Write to"
        - link "privacy@carosledge.com":
          - /url: mailto:privacy@carosledge.com
        - text: . We will tell you how to reach the authority for your country; you do not need our permission to complain.
    - paragraph: We respond to requests made by e-mail within 30 days.
    - heading "Use your rights here" [level=3]
    - button "Download my data"
    - button "Delete my account"
    - heading "California Residents (CCPA)" [level=3]
    - paragraph: California residents have specific rights including the right to know what personal information is collected, the right to delete personal information, and the right to opt out of the sale of personal information. We do not sell personal information.
    - heading "International Data Transfers" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Caro's Ledge operates globally. Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own, including the United States. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses to protect your information during international transfers.
    - heading "Data Security" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We implement reasonable technical and organizational security measures including:"
    - list:
      - listitem: Encryption of data in transit (TLS) and at rest
      - listitem: Access controls and authentication requirements
      - listitem: Regular security audits and updates
      - listitem: Incident response procedures
    - paragraph: No system is completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.
    - heading "Cookies and Tracking Technologies" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We use cookies and similar technologies to:"
    - list:
      - listitem: Maintain your authenticated session
      - listitem: Remember your preferences
    - paragraph: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect platform functionality.
    - paragraph: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
    - heading "Children's Privacy" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Caro's Ledge is a B2B platform and is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, contact us and we will delete it.
    - heading "Third-Party Links" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The platform may contain links to third-party websites including regulatory sources, official gazettes, and industry publications. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of third-party sites.
    - paragraph: "Data credits: Source: GeoNames, licensed under CC BY 4.0."
    - heading "Changes to This Policy" [level=2]
    - paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy. We will notify you of material changes through the platform. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the most recent revision.
    - heading "Contact" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices:"
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Pet Pursuit LLC
      - text: "50 Falls Road, Falls Village, CT 06031, USA Privacy contact:"
      - link "privacy@carosledge.com":
        - /url: mailto:privacy@carosledge.com
    - paragraph: "For EU/UK data subjects, our representative is: Caro's Ledge is currently in early access. EU/UK GDPR Article 27 representative will be designated upon onboarding of EU/UK data subjects."
    - heading "Data Protection Officer" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Pet Pursuit LLC has not appointed a dedicated Data Protection Officer. Privacy inquiries should be directed to
      - link "privacy@carosledge.com":
        - /url: mailto:privacy@carosledge.com
      - text: .
